title: [Repopay PYUSD devnet test] Leading JSON BOM support
criteria:
## Isolated Repopay PYUSD devnet walkthrough

Proposed reward: **1.00 test PYUSD on Solana devnet**, funded through the local Repopay app. These tokens have no monetary value. This detached demo repository does not affect PayPal upstream. Funding, reviews, merge and payout remain separate verified steps.

## Task

Update `Json.decode` in `lib/paypalhttp/serializer/json.js` so it accepts a JSON string beginning with exactly one Unicode BOM character (U+FEFF), by removing that leading character before parsing.

## Acceptance criteria

- A string with one leading U+FEFF followed by `{"example":123}` decodes to `{example:123}`.
- Normal JSON objects, arrays and scalar values still decode as before.
- A U+FEFF inside a JSON string value is preserved.
- Invalid JSON still throws `SyntaxError`; do not swallow parsing errors or strip arbitrary characters.
- Preserve existing tests. Add regression tests for these cases to `demo-test/serializers.test.cjs` and pass `node --test demo-test/serializers.test.cjs`.
- Keep the change limited to the decoder and regression tests.

Open a contributor PR referencing this issue. Leave it unmerged until its exact-revision CI and Repopay review have been checked. Wallet ownership is confirmed in Repopay; never post private keys or seed phrases.

This is the active single 1-PYUSD devnet walkthrough. Earlier attempts on issues #18, #19 and #20 expired before a signed transaction reached the application; chain checks found no reference transactions. Those checkouts remain on hold with original history preserved. Do not fund them.
